title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-21

ai_review.summary: Seamons matrix captures a fire‑filled NYC show with smoking Playing In The Band, Looks Like Rain, China Rider and an all‑time great Estimated.
ai_review.review: The recording is a top‑notch Hunter Seamons matrix that delivers crystal‑clear sound where every instrument is heard.  The performance is consistently high‑energy—from the surprise opening of Playing In The Band through a soaring Looks Like Rain, a monster China Rider and an inspired Estimated—making it one of the standout early‑80s shows.

ai_rating.rationale: Nearly all reviewers gave 5‑star ratings, praising both the exceptional matrix recording and the high‑energy, flawless performance; only one low rating and a single 4‑star comment were outliers.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Praised as a top‑notch Seamons matrix with crystal‑clear mix, perfect balance, and all band members audible; no noted dropouts or muffling.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Surprising opener with Playing In The Band, a tight first set that builds through Crazy Fingers and Looks Like Rain, climaxes with China Rider to close the set, then a second set featuring Throwing Stones/NFA in an unusual spot and a soaring Estimated.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as "liquid lightning" on guitar; highlighted lead work on Looks Like Rain and overall fire throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for “doing his thing” during Estimated outro, adding vocal and rhythmic flair.
